# AutoStacc

> AutoStacc sells sample packs, presets, stems and music straight from the artists who make them. Follow projects and get their free releases as they drop.

AutoStacc is the site at https://autostacc.com: a store for music, samples, presets, stems and visuals, straight from the projects (artists and creators) that make them. AutoStacc sells and delivers them, and keeps what each customer owns in their account. A project is never the site; each one has its own pages under https://autostacc.com/<creator>/<project>.

## Platform

- [Home](https://autostacc.com/): new releases, projects and how AutoStacc works
- [Store](https://autostacc.com/shop): digital downloads, delivered right after checkout (payments by Stripe)
- [About](https://autostacc.com/about): how AutoStacc works and what its words mean
- [Projects](https://autostacc.com/projects): every project on AutoStacc
- [Creators](https://autostacc.com/creators): every creator on AutoStacc and the projects they make
- [Events](https://autostacc.com/events): a calendar of what projects have coming up, where and when
- [Guides](https://autostacc.com/guide): step-by-step help for buying, Your Stacc and refunds, and the creator manual for the Studio, selling, packs and payouts

## Words

- Your Stacc: a customer's library of everything they own, from every project.
- Stacclet: a collection of related Pacs from one project.
- Pac: a folder of content (MIDI, samples, loops, presets and more).
- Auto-Stacc: adds a followed project's free releases to Your Stacc automatically; paid content is never added without buying it.

## Projects

### Glitches & Stitches

> An electronic music project that treats unfinished songs as raw material: fragments are torn out, stitched into new tracks and glitched into something new.

- [Home](https://autostacc.com/autostacc/glitches-and-stitches)
- [Music](https://autostacc.com/autostacc/glitches-and-stitches/music)
- [Events](https://autostacc.com/autostacc/glitches-and-stitches/events)
- [Press](https://autostacc.com/autostacc/glitches-and-stitches/press)
